anchor: centre of the canvas = centre of the car body; drive along the top-row centre line (board y = 16)
siren: alternate siren-a / siren-b every 120ms while the car is on duty

timing.hop_into_cage: one frog hop (330ms) from the tile centre to the cage: car centre - 8px; at landing swap car to <colour>-siren-*

sequence: 1. Car appears on the Jail tile (top-right corner), facing left, siren on.
2. Drive left to (frog tile centre + 28px). Show speed-lines behind it while moving.
3. U-turn in place: left -> turn-up -> right (90ms each) with a dust puff.
4. Frog hops right into the cage (car centre - 6px). On landing: car frame = <colour>-siren-*, 1px bump down for 120ms.
5. Drive right to the Jail tile centre, frog visible in the cage.
6. Pause 250ms, swap the Jail tile to jail/jail-with-<colour>.svg and the car to empty-siren-*.
7. Car drives right off the board (clip drawing to the board) and disappears; siren stops.
only_top_row: Jail is reached from "?" or the top row, so the car only drives horizontally along the top row.
